title: "Adult Sample Analysis"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script produces the results for the adult sample in Supplement 5, and the adult rows of Table 1 and Table 7 in the main text. It:

1. Prints the age, sex and ethnicity of the approved participants (S5.1).
2. Prints the number of participants, and saves the exclusion percentage of each task (S5.2).
3. Saves the adult rows of Table 1 (reliability) and Table 7 (accuracy and number attempted), for the cleaned and uncleaned scores (Tables S9.1 and S9.9). reliability_analysis.Rmd and descriptive_analysis.Rmd add these rows to the tables, so run this script first.
4. Saves the split-half reliability of each RT control block (S5.3.1).
5. Saves the correlations among the arithmetic fluency tasks (Table S5.1).
6. Saves the descriptive statistics of each task and modality (Table S5.2) and the score distributions (Figure S5.1).
7. Saves the modality and task regression models (Table S5.3).
8. Prints the cross-modality correlations corrected for measurement error, and saves those also controlling for simple response time (S5.3.3.2), calculated as in correlation_analysis.Rmd.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(psych)       # describe, for the descriptive statistics
library(splithalfr)  # spearman_brown, for the split-half reliabilities
library(gridExtra)   # arrangeGrob, to lay out Figure S5.1
library(grid)        # textGrob, for the Figure S5.1 axis titles
library(lme4)        # lmer
library(lmerTest)    # p-values for the fixed effects
library(performance) # icc, r2
```

# Paths

```{r}
adult_scores_dir <- here("data", "scores", "prolific")

results_dir <- here("results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# the scores file, where its results go, and the file names
versions <- list(
  cleaned     = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv",
                     results_dir = here("results"),
                     reliability_file = "table1_adults_reliability.csv",
                     acc_file = "table7_adults_accuracy_attempted.csv"),
  no_cleaning = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv",
                     results_dir = here("results", "no_cleaning"),
                     reliability_file = "sup9_table1_adults_reliability.csv",
                     acc_file = "sup9_table9_adults_accuracy_attempted.csv")
)

sub_data <- read.csv(file.path(adult_scores_dir, versions$cleaned$scores_file))
```

# S5.2: Sample and exclusions

```{r}
score_tasks <- c("RT Control FR" = "rtControl_score_production", "RT Control 2AFC" = "rtControl_score_2afc",
                 "RT Control 6AFC" = "rtControl_score_6afc", "ARF FR" = "arf_prod", "ARF FC" = "arf_2afc",
                 "CalF FR" = "calf_prod", "CalF FC" = "calf_6afc")

cat("Participants:", n_distinct(sub_data$ID),
    "; with all tasks:", sum(complete.cases(sub_data[, score_tasks])), "\n")

task_counts <- function(scores) sapply(score_tasks, function(task) sum(!is.na(scores[[task]])))

counts <- tibble(task = names(score_tasks),
                 initial_count = task_counts(read.csv(file.path(adult_scores_dir, "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv"))),
                 mid_count = task_counts(read.csv(file.path(adult_scores_dir, "scores_combined_rtFiltered.csv"))),
                 final_count = task_counts(sub_data))

exclusions <- counts %>%
  mutate(excluded = mid_count - final_count,
         exclusion_percent = round(excluded / initial_count * 100))

exclusions

write.csv(exclusions, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_exclusion_rates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Adult rows of Table 1 and Table 7

```{r}
adult_tasks <- c(arf_fr = "arf_prod", arf_fc = "arf_2afc", calf_fr = "calf_prod", calf_fc = "calf_6afc")

# Split-half reliability
adult_reliability <- function(scores) {
  imap_dfr(adult_tasks, function(task, name) {
    halves <- scores[complete.cases(scores[, c(task, paste0("even_", task), paste0("odd_", task))]), ]
    reliability <- spearman_brown(halves[[paste0("even_", task)]], halves[[paste0("odd_", task)]])
    tibble(task = name, n = nrow(halves), reliability = reliability)
  })
}

acc_columns <- tribble(
  ~condition,             ~accuracy,                       ~num_attempted,
  "arf_prod",             "accuracy_arf_prod",             "num_attempted_arf_prod",
  "arf_2afc",             "accuracy_arf_2afc",             "num_attempted_arf_2afc",
  "calf_prod",            "accuracy_calf_prod",            "num_attempted_calf_prod",
  "calf_6afc",            "accuracy_calf_6afc",            "num_attempted_calf_6afc",
  "rtControl_production", "rtControl_accuracy_production", "rtControl_num_attempted_production",
  "rtControl_2afc",       "rtControl_accuracy_2afc",       "rtControl_num_attempted_2afc",
  "rtControl_6afc",       "rtControl_accuracy_6afc",       "rtControl_num_attempted_6afc")

# Average accuracy and average number attempted
adult_accuracy <- function(scores) {
  acc_columns %>%
    mutate(acc = map2_chr(accuracy, num_attempted, function(acc_col, att_col) {
      keep <- !is.na(scores[[acc_col]])
      paste0(round(mean(scores[[acc_col]][keep])*100), "% (", round(mean(scores[[att_col]][keep])), ")")
    })) %>%
    dplyr::select(condition, acc)
}

for (v in versions) {
  dir.create(v$results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  scores <- read.csv(file.path(adult_scores_dir, v$scores_file))

  reliability_row <- adult_reliability(scores) %>%
    mutate(rel = paste0(sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", reliability)), " (", n, ")")) %>%
    dplyr::select(task, rel) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = rel) %>%
    mutate(grades = "Adults", .before = 1)

  acc_row <- adult_accuracy(scores) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = acc) %>%
    mutate(grade_bin = "Adults", .before = 1)

  print(reliability_row)
  print(acc_row)

  write.csv(reliability_row, file.path(v$results_dir, v$reliability_file), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(acc_row, file.path(v$results_dir, v$acc_file), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# S5.3.1: RT control reliability

```{r}
rt_blocks <- c(FR = "production", "2AFC" = "2afc", "6AFC" = "6afc")

rtControl_rel <- imap_dfr(rt_blocks, function(block, block_name) {
  halves <- sub_data[complete.cases(sub_data[, paste0(c("rtControl_first_", "rtControl_second_"), block)]), ]
  reliability <- spearman_brown(halves[[paste0("rtControl_first_", block)]], halves[[paste0("rtControl_second_", block)]])
  tibble(block = block_name, n = nrow(halves), reliability = round(reliability, 2))
})

rtControl_rel

write.csv(rtControl_rel, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_reliability_rtControl.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Table S5.1: Correlations among the arithmetic fluency tasks

```{r}
tasks <- c("ARF FR" = "arf_prod", "ARF FC" = "arf_2afc", "CalF FR" = "calf_prod", "CalF FC" = "calf_6afc")

cor_mat <- cor(sub_data[, tasks], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
dimnames(cor_mat) <- list(names(tasks), names(tasks))

tableS5_1 <- matrix("", length(tasks), length(tasks), dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))
tableS5_1[lower.tri(tableS5_1)] <- sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)]))
diag(tableS5_1) <- "-"

tableS5_1

write.csv(tableS5_1, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_table1_correlations.csv"))
```

# Table S5.2: Descriptive statistics

```{r}
dist_control <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, rtControl_score_2afc, rtControl_score_6afc, rtControl_score_production,
                rtControl_accuracy_2afc, rtControl_accuracy_6afc, rtControl_accuracy_production,
                rtControl_num_attempted_2afc, rtControl_num_attempted_6afc, rtControl_num_attempted_production) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = c(".value", "condition"), names_pattern = "rtControl_(score|accuracy|num_attempted)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("production", "6afc", "2afc"), labels = c("FR", "6AFC", "2AFC")),
         task = "RT Control")

dist_arf <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, arf_2afc, arf_prod, num_attempted_arf_prod, num_attempted_arf_2afc, accuracy_arf_prod, accuracy_arf_2afc) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = c(".value", "condition"), names_pattern = "(arf|accuracy_arf|num_attempted_arf)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("prod", "2afc"), labels = c("FR", "2AFC")),
         task = "ARF") %>%
  rename(score = arf, num_attempted = num_attempted_arf, accuracy = accuracy_arf)

dist_calf <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, calf_6afc, calf_prod, num_attempted_calf_prod, num_attempted_calf_6afc, accuracy_calf_prod, accuracy_calf_6afc) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = c(".value", "condition"), names_pattern = "(calf|accuracy_calf|num_attempted_calf)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("prod", "6afc"), labels = c("FR", "6AFC")),
         task = "CalF") %>%
  rename(score = calf, num_attempted = num_attempted_calf, accuracy = accuracy_calf)

dist_plot <- rbind(dist_control, dist_arf, dist_calf) %>%
  mutate(task = factor(task, levels = c("RT Control", "ARF", "CalF")))

described <- dist_plot %>%
  mutate(condition = paste(task, condition)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-task) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = c(score, num_attempted, accuracy)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
  describe()

tableS5_2 <- described[c("score_RT Control FR", "score_RT Control 6AFC", "score_RT Control 2AFC", "score_ARF FR", "score_ARF 2AFC", "score_CalF FR", "score_CalF 6AFC"), ] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "condition") %>%
  mutate(condition = str_remove(condition, "^score_"),
         variability = sd/mean) %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, n, mean, sd, variability, skew, kurtosis) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean, sd, variability, skew, kurtosis), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  left_join(dist_plot %>%
              mutate(condition = paste(task, condition)) %>%
              group_by(condition) %>%
              summarise(avg_attempted = round(mean(num_attempted)),
                        avg_accuracy = round(mean(accuracy)*100, 2)),
            by = "condition")

tableS5_2

write.csv(tableS5_2, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_table2_descriptive_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Figure S5.1: Score distributions

```{r}
cond_cols <- c("6AFC" = "#009E73", "FR" = "#E69F00", "2AFC" = "#0072B2")

dist_stats <- dist_plot %>%
  group_by(condition, task) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(score), se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

plot_task <- function(task_name, x_breaks, x_limits, y_breaks, y_limits, title = task_name, show_legend = FALSE) {
  task_stats <- dist_stats[dist_stats$task == task_name, ]

  dist_plot %>%
    filter(task == task_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = score, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.15, adjust = 2, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = task_stats, aes(xintercept = mean_val, color = condition),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_rect(data = task_stats, aes(xmin = mean_val - se, xmax = mean_val + se, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = condition),
              alpha = 0.12, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, fill = "Condition", color = "Condition") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_limits) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          strip.text = element_blank(),
          legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
}

p_rt <- plot_task("RT Control", seq(0,60,10), c(0,60), seq(0,0.12,0.03), c(0,0.12))
p_arf <- plot_task("ARF", seq(0,150,50), c(-20,180), seq(0,0.016,0.004), c(0,0.016))
p_calf <- plot_task("CalF", seq(-10,70,10), c(-10,70), seq(0,0.048,0.012), c(0,0.048))

legend_plot <- plot_task("RT Control", seq(0,60,10), c(0,60), seq(0,0.12,0.03), c(0,0.12), title = NULL, show_legend = TRUE) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
legend_gtable <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(legend_plot))
legend <- legend_gtable$grobs[[which(sapply(legend_gtable$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]]

figS5_1 <- arrangeGrob(arrangeGrob(p_rt, p_arf, p_calf, ncol = 3), legend, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = c(10,1),
                       left = textGrob(expression(paste("Density")), rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontfamily = "Arial")),
                       bottom = textGrob("Score", gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontfamily = "Arial")))
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(figS5_1)

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "sup5_figure1_task_distributions.png"), plot = figS5_1, width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Table S5.3: Modality and task models

```{r}
lm_data <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc), names_to = "condition", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(task = factor(ifelse(grepl("arf", condition), "ARF", "CALF"), levels = c("CALF", "ARF")),
         modality = factor(ifelse(grepl("prod", condition), "FR", "FC"), levels = c("FR", "FC")))

m_task <- lmer(score ~ modality*task + (1|ID), data = lm_data)
m_arf <- lmer(score ~ modality + (1|ID), data = lm_data %>% filter(task == "ARF"))
m_calf <- lmer(score ~ modality + (1|ID), data = lm_data %>% filter(task == "CALF"))

term_labels <- c("(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
                 "taskARF" = "Task [ARF]",
                 "modalityFC" = "Modality [FC]",
                 "modalityFC:taskARF" = "Modality [FC] x Task [ARF]",
                 "ID" = "Between Participant",
                 "Residual" = "Within Participant")

model_column <- function(mod, model_name) {
  coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(mod)$coefficients)
  stars <- as.character(cut(coefs[["Pr(>|t|)"]], breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
                            labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "")))
  bind_rows(tibble(term = rownames(coefs), value = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", coefs$Estimate), stars)),
            as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod)) %>% transmute(term = grp, value = sprintf("%.2f", vcov)),
            tibble(term = c("ICC (adjusted)", "Conditional R2", "Number of participants"),
                   value = c(sprintf("%.2f", performance::icc(mod)$ICC_adjusted),
                             sprintf("%.2f", performance::r2(mod)$R2_conditional),
                             as.character(ngrps(mod)[["ID"]])))) %>%
    mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_labels)) %>%
    rename(!!model_name := value)
}

tableS5_3 <- imap(list(combined_model = m_task, arf_model = m_arf, calf_model = m_calf), model_column) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "term") %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c(term_labels, "ICC (adjusted)", "Conditional R2", "Number of participants"))) %>%
  arrange(term) %>%
  mutate(term = as.character(term)) %>%
  add_row(term = "Fixed Effects (b)", .before = 1) %>%
  add_row(term = "Random Effects (Variance)", .before = which(.$term == "Between Participant")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")))

tableS5_3

write.csv(tableS5_3, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_table3_regression_task_models.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# S5.3.3.2: Cross-modality correlations

## Corrected for measurement error

```{r}
reliability <- adult_reliability(sub_data) %>%
  mutate(reliability = round(reliability, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(task, reliability) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = reliability)

disattenuate <- function(r, rel_fr, rel_fc) round(r, 2) / sqrt(rel_fr * rel_fc)

cat(sprintf("Cross-modality r: ARF = %.2f, CalF = %.2f\n", cor_mat["ARF FC", "ARF FR"], cor_mat["CalF FC", "CalF FR"]))
cat(sprintf("Corrected for measurement error: ARF = %.2f, CalF = %.2f\n",
            disattenuate(cor_mat["ARF FC", "ARF FR"], reliability$arf_fr, reliability$arf_fc),
            disattenuate(cor_mat["CalF FC", "CalF FR"], reliability$calf_fr, reliability$calf_fc)))
```

## Corrected for measurement error and simple response time

```{r}
raw_resid_cor <- function(raw_task, resid_task) {
  round(cor(sub_data[[paste0("even_", raw_task)]], sub_data[[paste0("resid_score_odd_", resid_task)]], use = "complete.obs"), 2)
}

rt_corrected <- function(task, fr, fc) {
  tibble(task = task,
         matched_fr = raw_resid_cor(fr, fr),     # raw FR half with residual FR half
         matched_fc = raw_resid_cor(fc, fc),     # raw FC half with residual FC half
         cross_fr_fc = raw_resid_cor(fr, fc),    # raw FR half with residual FC half
         cross_fc_fr = raw_resid_cor(fc, fr)) %>% # raw FC half with residual FR half
    mutate(corrected_r = round(sqrt(cross_fr_fc * cross_fc_fr) / sqrt(matched_fr * matched_fc), 3))
}

rt_corrected_cor <- bind_rows(rt_corrected("ARF", "arf_prod", "arf_2afc"),
                              rt_corrected("CalF", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc"))

rt_corrected_cor

write.csv(rt_corrected_cor, file.path(results_dir, "sup5_corr_corrected_rtControl.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
